name: Asian femoral head calibration estimates
intendedUse: Fallback estimate for X-ray calibration when no physical calibration marker is available.
warning: Use a radiographic marker, ruler, calibration ball, DICOM PixelSpacing, or known implant diameter whenever available. Height-based femoral head size is an estimate and can be inaccurate for implant templating.
basis: Field-oriented conservative presets for Asian/Indonesian adult AP hip templating.
Female femoral head estimates are generally smaller than male estimates.
38-39 mm is treated as extra-small and low-confidence, not a default adult preset.
